paras: Cryptoblepharus mertensi, also known commonly as Merten's snake-eyed skink, is a species of lizard in the subfamily Eugongylinae of the family Scincidae. The species is endemic to the Northern Territory in Australia.
The specific name, mertensi, is in honor of German herpetologist Robert Mertens.
The preferred natural habitat of  Cryptoblepharus mertensi is forest.
Small for its genus and short-legged for its genus, Cryptoblepharus mertensi may attain a snout-to-vent length (SVL) of 4 cm (1.6 in).
